name: Blowpipe Ranger
tagline: Kills from beyond the treeline, one poisoned dart at a time.

abilities.name: TOXIC DART
abilities.description: A fast poisoned dart that leaves the target venomed.

abilities.name: DART VOLLEY
abilities.description: A fan of five darts that poisons every enemy it hits.

abilities.name: RANGER'S FOOTWORK
abilities.description: The ranger hops backwards and attacks faster for a few seconds.

abilities.name: DEADSHOT
abilities.description: A piercing blowpipe shot that hits everything in its line and finishes off wounded targets.
